stage_meaning.10: dedicated audit and acceptance scope exist
stage_meaning.25: architecture or delivery contract is accepted
stage_meaning.40: core implementation exists with focused automated evidence
stage_meaning.55: the gate's canonical internal path is integrated end-to-end
stage_meaning.70: the gate's real user-facing or operational path is wired
stage_meaning.85: regression/E2E, exact-head CI, APK/device evidence applicable to the gate are complete
stage_meaning.100: the gate Definition of Done is complete, status/handoff is current, and no gate acceptance gap remains

gates.name: Unified Item + adapter/migration + regression
gates.note: Home renders, edits, searches and saves canonical Task objects directly while preserving additive fields. Final gate-level physical-device/E2E and handoff closure remain before 85/100.

gates.name: Notebook UI + persistence
gates.note: Notebook editor/read-only/edit/autosave/checklist flow is user-facing and persists through canonical TaskStore only. Final physical-device/E2E and handoff closure remain.

gates.name: Home + Search on canonical Item path
gates.note: Real Home/Search/Today/About are wired directly to canonical Task. Persian semantic expansion is merged on the same SearchService path with exact-head and post-merge emulator/APK evidence; physical-device/E2E gate closure remains.

gates.name: Calendar + Prayer Times + Iranian Holidays
gates.note: Official calendar, Iranian holidays and calculated prayer times are merged on the existing user-facing calendar path. Final physical-device/E2E and handoff closure remain.

gates.name: Widget + Lock Screen validation
gates.note: Canonical Android home/keyguard widget and Task-id bridge are wired. Physical launcher/keyguard/resize/row-tap acceptance remains before 85/100.

gates.name: PDF + Print + IranSans
gates.note: Canonical A4 RTL PDF/Print flow with bundled Persian typography and optional licensed IRANSansX is user-facing and merged. Physical print/share/device acceptance remains.

gates.name: Reminder/Google Calendar + Backup/Dropbox
gates.note: Reminder, portable backup/restore with Settings, Dropbox foundations and system-calendar export are merged. Privacy audit now defines the safe future encryption boundary without changing current storage semantics. Physical-device integration and final handoff closure remain.

gates.name: E2E + device release + APK evidence
gates.note: Exact-head Parallel/Build/Device validation, deterministic device fallback and parallel release/debug APK production are merged and proven on PR heads and main. Physical-device end-to-end acceptance remains the blocker before stage 85/100.
